verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 30 idiomatic SDKs, OpenFeature providers, and edge SDKs (e.g., Cloudflare) plus a CLI and MCP server for AI-native/agentic workflows, giving developers official building blocks across languages and AI tooling. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reviews specifically praising SDK quality/documentation depth, and no evidence of AI-specific SDK features (e.g., LLM-context helpers) beyond general SDK/OpenFeature support.
